weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 你好，牡羊座！今天對你來說將會是美好的一天。天體的影響力閃閃發光，尤其是在溝通和社交互動領域。擁抱這令人振奮的能量！如果可以的話，與朋友和家人歡聚一堂，享受一次愉快的聚會。無論是舉辦遊戲之夜還是晚宴，甚至是虛擬交流，都可以充分利用這個機會。聚餐可以增添樂趣！請記住，您每天都付出了很多努力，所以今天花一些時間放鬆並享受自己。
aries.horoscope_en: Hello, Aries! Today is shaping up to be a fantastic day for you. The celestial influences are shining brightly, particularly in the realm of communication and social interactions. Embrace this uplifting energy! If you can, gather with friends and family for a delightful get-together. Whether it's hosting a game night or a dinner party, or even connecting virtually, make the most of this opportunity. A potluck could add a fun twist! Remember, you put in a lot of effort every day, so take some time to relax and enjoy yourself today.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天是與你所愛的人聯繫並一起踏上冒險的絕佳機會。天體排列鼓勵你充分利用這段時間與最重要的人在一起。如果您有一個渴望探索的目的地，請抓住時機，實現它！召集您的家人，出發去一次愉快的郊遊，去發現新的事物。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, today is an excellent opportunity to connect with your loved ones and embark on an adventure together. The celestial alignments are encouraging you to make the most of this time with those who matter most. If there's a destination you've been eager to explore, seize the day and make it happen! Gather your family and set off for a delightful outing to discover something new.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，為什麼不利用你的哲學思考並將其轉化為創意寫作呢？您可能會發現這是一次愉快的體驗。即使您以前從未涉足過這個領域，今天也是嘗試的絕佳機會。無論是詩歌還是講故事，盡情發揮你的想像。如果這感覺難以承受，請考慮開始寫日記。它可以成為收集您的想法和反思的絕佳空間。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, why not tap into your philosophical musings and turn them into creative writing? You might find it to be a delightful experience. Even if you haven't ventured into this realm before, today is the perfect opportunity to give it a shot. Whether it's poetry or storytelling, let your imagination flow. If that feels overwhelming, consider starting a journal instead. It can serve as a wonderful space to gather your thoughts and reflections.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，你可能會發現孤獨正在呼喚你。雖然您經常發現自己與他人在一起，但為自己創造一些時刻很重要。獨自思考自己的想法和情緒對於您的健康至關重要，尤其是考慮到您的敏感性格。在喧囂之中，優先考慮一些安靜的時間來培養你內在自我的這一重要面向。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you may find that solitude is calling your name. While you often find yourself in the company of others, it's essential to carve out moments for yourself. Being alone with your thoughts and emotions is vital for your well-being, especially given your sensitive disposition. Amidst the hustle and bustle, prioritize some quiet time to nurture this important aspect of your inner self.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你可能會強烈渴望走自己的路，即使它與別人的願望不同。你的獨立感至關重要，但找到中間立場可以幫助你避免任何潛在的分歧。考慮在個人需求和對你重要的人之間平衡你的時間。以輕鬆、體貼的方式與親人分享您對獨處的需求，他們很可能會非常願意理解和支持您的選擇。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might feel a strong urge to follow your own path, even if it diverges from what others desire. Your sense of independence is vital, yet finding a middle ground could help you steer clear of any potential disagreements. Think about balancing your time between your personal needs and the people who matter to you. Share your need for solitude with your loved ones in a light-hearted and thoughtful manner, and they will likely be more than willing to understand and support your choice.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天召喚你去擁抱冒險的感覺，或者如果可以的話，也許去拜訪一下。回想一下您上次花一天時間做這樣有趣的事情是什麼時候——可能已經有一段時間了！您不僅會在體驗中找到樂趣，而且您周圍的人也會很高興與您分享。無論您選擇帶朋友一起還是獨自冒險，都可以藉此機會與他人聯繫或探索新地方。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, today is calling you to embrace a sense of adventure or perhaps make a visit if you can. Reflect on when you last dedicated a day to something fun like this—it might have been a while! You'll not only find joy in the experience, but those around you will also be excited to share in your company. Whether you choose to bring a friend along or venture out solo, take this chance to connect with others or explore a new place.

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你深入思考和有效溝通的能力得到了提升。這些已經是你的強項，有了這些額外的能量，找到表達自己的方式就很重要了。寫日記是一種極好的發洩方式，參與對話也是。如果您有任何疑慮或挑戰，請聚集相關人員並分享您的感受。這一天適合尋找任何問題的解決方案。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, your ability to think deeply and communicate effectively is heightened. These are already your strong suits, and with this extra energy, it's essential to find a way to express yourself. Writing in a journal can be a fantastic outlet, as can engaging in conversation. If you have any concerns or challenges, gather those involved and share your feelings. This is an ideal day for finding solutions to any issues.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你可能會發現自己處於一種壓力之下，要履行不適合你的承諾。無論是承諾承擔一項任務，還是有人提醒你所欠的人情，表達你的不適都很重要。今天的宇宙氛圍使您能夠清晰地溝通並確保您的感受得到認可。推遲你的義務可能比懷抱揮之不去的怨恨更明智。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you may find yourself in a situation where you feel pressured to fulfill a commitment that doesn't sit well with you. Whether it's a promise to take on a task or someone reminding you of a favor owed, it's important to voice your discomfort. The cosmic vibes today empower you to communicate clearly and ensure your feelings are acknowledged. It might be wiser to postpone your obligations rather than harboring any lingering resentment.

sagittarius.horoscope: Today, Sagittarius, keep an eye out for someone in your inner circle who may be struggling but is too proud to reach out for assistance. Don’t let their hesitation hold you back. If you notice an opportunity to lend a hand, seize it! Take the initiative without waiting for them to ask. Your willingness to step in will not only be valued, but it will also bring you a sense of fulfillment knowing you’ve made a positive impact.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，你上次拿起筆和紙是什麼時候？在我們的數位時代，這些永恆的工具已經退居二線。就像散步不僅僅提供呼吸新鮮空氣一樣，寫作的觸覺體驗也可以令人難以置信的平靜和恢復，通常比我們想像的還要多。手在頁面上滑動的簡單動作可能非常令人愉快，可以觸及打字無法觸及的情感和想法。試一試吧！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, when did you last pick up a pen and paper? In our digital age, these timeless tools have taken a backseat. Just as a stroll offers more than just a breath of fresh air, the tactile experience of writing can be incredibly calming and restorative, often more than we acknowledge. The simple act of gliding your hand across the page can be quite pleasurable, tapping into emotions and thoughts that typing simply can't reach. Give it a go!

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天你可能會發現你的同理心和與他人溝通的能力都增強了。您的溝通技巧很到位，因此這是與對您最重要的人討論任何挑戰或疑慮的理想時機。考慮透過拜訪或打電話來解決任何懸而未決的問題。最重要的是，不要猶豫——公開表達你的感受，讓你所愛的人知道他們對你有多重要。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today you may find your ability to empathize and connect with others heightened. Your communication skills are on point, making it an ideal time to discuss any challenges or concerns with those who matter most to you. Consider reaching out with a visit or a phone call to resolve any lingering issues. Above all, don’t hold back—let your loved ones know just how much they mean to you by expressing your feelings openly.

pisces.horoscope: 今天，雙魚座，你的思緒可能會以閃電般的速度運轉，這使得踩剎車變得困難。為腦海中盤旋的想法找到一個出口是至關重要的。天體排列有利於清晰的溝通，因此請考慮大聲分享您的想法或給您信任的觀點的人寫一條訊息。即使是簡單的塗鴉也可以作為您精神能量的創造性釋放。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, your thoughts may race at lightning speed, making it challenging to hit the brakes. It's essential to find an outlet for the whirlwind of ideas swirling in your mind. The celestial alignments favor clear communication, so consider sharing your thoughts aloud or penning a message to someone whose perspective you trust. Even a simple doodle can serve as a creative release for your mental energy.
